Never edit storygame/, packages/, data/, docs/, bench/, .plans/, or any existing script or test (including probe.py and probe2.py, which you import from). The preregistration you implement is .plans/1a-opening-and-truck-feedback/probe3-prereg.md: read it first, it holds the exact arm text, counts and scoring. Read scripts/ringer/opening_truck/probe2.py and probe.py fully first and reuse their helpers and CLI shape (_control_request, _check_control, _arm_one_for_command, _insert_after_driver_seat, REACH_LINE, _assert_only_added, _opening_request, _canonical_hash, _diff, _offline_worker_environment, _scripted_jev, _record, _quota_row, _validate_live_guard, and boarding_probe's CallCounter, QuotaExceeded, CallCapExceeded, _send_narrator, _jsonable, _write_json).

BUILD scripts/ringer/opening_truck/probe3.py, CLI `(--dry | --smoke | --run) --out PATH [--max-calls N] [--confirm]`, default max-calls 80, narrator calls only (no Jev calls in this probe).
1. build_document(), offline, no network:
 a. Q1 arms: for each of the commands 'head out to the truck' and 'go to the truck': take the probe 2 arm 2 user text (control with the raw '- <command>' line removed, then the REACH_LINE inserted after the driver's-seat SCENE bullet). Arm 3 inserts the line `- Kristin looks around from the driver's seat.` and arm 4 inserts `- Kristin takes in what she can see and reach from the driver's seat.` in the position the raw command line had: between the line `- Kristin. Place: driver's seat.` and the line starting `- Already done:`. Assert each arm's diff against the arm 2 text is exactly one added line (use probe2._assert_only_added) and that the PLAYER block order is place line, action line, Already done line.
 b. Q2: a product-wired replay like probe2._new_product_replay but with the scripted Jev answering boards_vehicle NO for every command (only_boards_vehicle no), route 'open the drawer', 'feel in the gap', 'go out to the truck'; keep the narrator request sent on the last turn as arm 0 (assert it contains '- go out to the truck', contains no 'Already done:', and has no line starting '- Kristin's truck. Place'). Arm T1 = arm 0 plus the THINGS bullet `- Kristin's truck. Place: outside the house.` If the request has a 'THINGS:' section, append the bullet to the end of that section; otherwise create 'THINGS:\n<bullet>\n\n' directly before the 'CONSTRAINTS:' line. Assert the diff is exactly the added bullet line (plus the 'THINGS:' header and one blank line when the section is created) and nothing else.
 c. Q3 arm O2: the shipped opening user text (probe._opening_request) with these four SCENE bullets inserted, in order, immediately after the line starting `- Kristin Schweitzer's objective is` (use the same insertion approach as probe2._opening_arm_one): `- Kristin has already stepped inside and stands in Michelle's kitchen, beside the forced back door.` / `- The workstation is across the kitchen from the back door. Its chair lies on its side in front of it.` / `- Michelle's phone lies on the kitchen floor.` / `- The KMS cuts in the drawer front are pale and clean. They are Kristin's own initials, carved into Michelle's workstation.` Assert the diff is exactly those four added lines.
 d. Record every diff, the control requests and a document hash.
2. Plan (all narrator calls, via probe._send_narrator): Q1 arm 3 and arm 4 for both commands, 10 samples each (40 calls); Q2 arm 0 and T1, 10 each (20 calls); Q3 O2 x 10 (10 calls). Total 70. Interleave samples within each question (round-robin over arms) with variant labels (q1_arm3, q1_arm4, q2_control, q2_t1, q3_o2) and the command. The cap check before the first call rejects a planned total above --max-calls (so --max-calls 69 is refused).
3. --dry writes the document and makes zero calls (print 'dry: document built, 70 planned calls, 0 calls'). --smoke (billed, needs --confirm) is exactly 5 calls: Q1 arm 3 on 'head out to the truck', Q1 arm 4 on 'go to the truck', Q2 arm 0, Q2 T1, Q3 O2, first sample of each. --run (billed, needs --confirm) is all 70. Without --confirm any billed mode exits non-zero with no call. Refuse a billed mode when CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL is empty or the placeholder https://w.example. Stop immediately and keep partial rows on a 429, AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or AI_DAILY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. No retries, no replacement samples. Write the result JSON after every call. Output: mode, document_hash, planned_calls, max_calls, calls_made, stop_reason, rows (each with part/question, variant, command, sample, system, user and the narrator reply fields).

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_opening_truck_probe3.py (hermetic; any real urlopen or socket reached fails the test; monkeypatch storygame.runtime.cloudflare.urlopen): each arm adds exactly its registered lines; the Q2 control has no Already done and no truck place line; plan totals 40/20/10/70 and --max-calls 69 is rejected; billed modes without --confirm exit non-zero with zero calls; the placeholder URL is refused; a fake narrator drives a full --run to 70 rows with the expected round-robin; a fake 429 stops and keeps partial rows; --smoke makes exactly 5 calls. DONE WHEN the check passes. Report which helpers you imported and anything you could not do.
